title: Outstanding drummers of the old days
summary: Morris names Happy Goldstein, Bill Norton, Arthur Oglin and Sammy Penn as outstanding drummers.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who was some of the outstanding drummers in the old days?
Well, in the old days, I tell you, Happy is an outstanding drummer.
From up on Louisiana. Used to live on Louisiana Avenue. He used to play with me.
No. Black Happy. Black Happy. Happy Goldstein. Happy Goldstein. That's right. Mr. Bill Norton. Now, he's an outstanding drummer. Arthur Oglin, that's an outstanding drummer. Them good drummers.
